visual_storytelling.approval_scope: Applied working shot direction requested by Jake; no generated-pixel or publication approval.

continuity_policy: Every set has a practical source of light and evidence of maintenance and earlier wear.
Atlas names are proposed child sites until authority promotes them.
Match previous actual artwork before fixing basketball/soccer geometry.
Keep Niño front spatially and temporally graded, not identical weather everywhere.
One image depicts one decisive moment; narration supplements rather than captions obvious action.
No new character look or title/belt changes without approved reference.
Source finality and legibility gates remain blocking.
